_comment: Ground truth for oedipus-vulnapp (VULNAPP_SAFE=0), the project's own target. Every row is a bug planted on purpose in vulnapp/app.py and reproduced against the running app. The hardened build (VULNAPP_SAFE=1) fixes all of them, so all checks are used for the safe-target false-positive control. Match key = check|METHOD|path.

expected.note: GET /api/products/search?q=' returns sqlite3.OperationalError; q is string-concatenated into the LIKE clause. The parameterized /api/products/{id} lookalike stays silent.
Debug dump serializes every user's cleartext password and api token.
register binds admin straight from the request body; the created principal comes back admin:true in /api/debug/users.
user_b reads user_a's note (and its secret canary) with no object-level ownership check.
Tokens are HS256-signed with 'changeme', a line in payloads/jwt-secrets.txt; oedipus verifies the target's own token signature offline.
/api/me accepts an unsigned alg=none token (server decodes without verifying the signature).

url-preview fetches an attacker-controlled URL with no egress allowlist and reflects the body; pointed at the internal metadata mock it returns 'ami-id'. The /api/url-preview-safe lookalike (allowlist) stays silent.
